question: By what percentage of the bare-Al value did the carbon layer reduce the sodium nucleation overpotential?
rendered: The carbon layer reduced the sodium nucleation overpotential from 19 to 12 mV. To calculate the percentage reduction, we can use the formula: ((19 - 12) / 19) * 100% ≈ 36.8%.
